4933c15575e93049ffd5668bdc86918ef3611289.summary: An interview with the person who calls himself LockbItSupp, leader of the LockBit ransomware gang. He denies being Dmitry Khoroshev, the Russian national that U.S. and British authorities identified and charged with 26 criminal counts. He says law enforcement attached the wrong person to his alias and that the gang is still planning attacks despite the February seizure of its servers. The interview was conducted over an encrypted messaging app, translated from Russian, and edited for clarity and length.
